run_bop24_evaluation: run the BOP24 pose evaluation script on result CSV files to compute mAP scores
run_mssd_mspd_errors: run MSSD and MSPD pose error calculations on 6D object detection results
run_parallel_score_calc: run parallel performance score calculation using multiple workers for BOP24 evaluation
run_gpu_pose_eval: run GPU-accelerated pose error calculation using torch for BOP24 evaluation
run_bop_results_load: run the evaluation script to load and validate BOP19 format result files
